dedupe_keys.name: replication package for the article bridging the gap towards a holistic understanding of shared micromobility fleet development dynamics

description: Shanaz Nabila Fuady and coauthors publish a system-dynamics model of shared-micromobility fleet development. Zenodo provides a Vensim Packaged Model and CSV outputs for ten policy packages under CC BY-SA 4.0. The description says the free Vensim Model Reader can view and simulate the packaged model. Published scenarios include fleet caps, management, user or operator fees and subsidy combinations, with time-series outputs for model variables. This model can compare fleet growth and policy choices in urban micromobility planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this packaged model. Geographic calibration is not established from the landing-page description, so transfer to a particular city needs input review. A limitation is that the downloadable file is a packaged model, which may be viewable and runnable without exposing an editable source formulation. The paper is described as submitted; acceptance is not established. Neither the packaged model nor CSV results were downloaded, and policy outcomes were not reproduced.
